title: AINM Protocol - Security Schema
description: Security domain types for the AI-Native Messaging Protocol v0.1.0. Covers message signing, verification, trust annotations, and deduplication. See spec/security.md.

SignedMessage.description: A message envelope with Ed25519 signature. The signing input is constructed by: (1) removing the signature field, (2) canonicalizing per RFC 8785, (3) encoding as UTF-8 bytes, (4) signing with Ed25519. See security.md Section 4.

CanonicalSigningInput.description: Describes the construction of the signing input for Ed25519 signatures. The process: clone the message envelope, remove the 'signature' field, apply RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (sort keys lexicographically by UTF-16 code units, remove whitespace, serialize numbers per ECMAScript rules), encode canonical JSON string as UTF-8 bytes. See security.md Section 4.1.

const: Canonicalize using RFC 8785 (JCS): sort keys, remove whitespace, normalize numbers
Encode canonical JSON string as UTF-8 bytes
Sign UTF-8 bytes with Ed25519 private key (RFC 8032)
Encode 64-byte signature as base64url without padding

TrustAnnotation.description: Trust annotation model for content blocks. The source field on each content block identifies content origin and is covered by the message signature. Cross-checking source against sender type from identity resolution detects misattribution. See security.md Section 6.

source.description: Content origin: user = human-authored, agent = AI-generated, system = protocol/server-generated.

cross_check_rules.description: Recommended cross-check: if sender type is 'agent' but source is 'user', content may be misattributed. If sender type is 'human' but source is 'system', content may be misattributed. Clients SHOULD flag mismatches.

VerificationResult.description: Result of verifying a message's Ed25519 signature. See security.md Section 5.

signer.description: The AINM address of the message sender whose key was used for verification.

key_id.description: Identifier of the key used for verification (current key or a historical key ID).

DeduplicationPolicy.description: Deduplication policy for at-least-once delivery. Implementations track message IDs to discard duplicates. See security.md Section 7.

window_size.description: Minimum number of message IDs to track. SHOULD be at least 10,000.

window_duration_hours.description: Minimum time window for message ID retention. SHOULD be at least 24 hours.

mechanism.description: Recommended deduplication mechanism. UUIDv7's time-ordered structure enables efficient sliding-window deduplication.

SecurityErrorCodes.description: Security-related JSON-RPC error codes. Range: -32010 to -32013. See security.md Section 8.1.

const.name: InvalidSignature
const.description: Ed25519 signature verification failed against all candidate keys (current and historical)

const.name: UnknownSender
const.description: Sender address could not be resolved via identity resolution

const.name: RevokedKey
const.description: Message signed with a key that has revocation_reason: compromised

const.name: MalformedMessage
const.description: Message missing required fields or contains invalid field formats

ReplayProtection.description: Replay attack mitigation parameters. See security.md Section 9.1.

max_future_drift_seconds.description: Reject messages with timestamps more than 5 minutes in the future.

max_past_drift_hours.description: Reject messages with timestamps more than 24 hours in the past.
